example_sentences_in_bangla: আমি কারও খিদমতগারি করতে পারব না।
তিনি সারা জীবন রাজার খিদমত করেছেন।
example_sentences_in_english: I cannot serve in anyone's employment or servitude.
He spent his whole life in the king's service.
history: Derived from Persian-Arabic 'khidmat', influenced by Mughal-era administrative language in Bengal.
note: Often implies subservient or menial work in Bengali usage.
